name: rinkou-hypernova
description: PPT generator for HyperNova (CRYPTO 2024) 2nd-round rinkou presentation

scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const BAD=/[\u201c\u201d\u2018\u2019\u00a0]/g;let ok=true;for(const fn of fs.readdirSync('./slides').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'))){const src=fs.readFileSync('./slides/'+fn,'utf8');const lines=src.split('\n');for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){const m=lines[i].match(BAD);if(m){console.error('NON-ASCII in slides/'+fn+':'+(i+1)+' -> '+JSON.stringify(m));ok=false}}}if(!ok){process.exit(1)}else{console.log('Pre-compile lint passed.')}"
